grounding.note: Establishes plan-submission requirement within six months of permit effective date and post-approval quarterly sampling during permit years 2–5, but does not state the permit effective date, any submission/approval facts, or FY2025 permit-year mapping.

Provides Part I.B Delta-BHC Study regulatory text (plan submission, approval, and sampling frequency/scope by permit year) without permit effective date, plan submission/approval status, or Federal FY2025 permit-year correspondence.
Packet acknowledges it may be evidence-insufficient for obligation adjudication.

payload.rationale: The obligation demands determining which Delta-BHC study obligations (plan submission and sample collection/analysis) were applicable during Federal FY2025, conditioned on permit effective date, plan approval status, and permit year. The packet grounds the regulatory conditions in Part I.B (six-month plan submission after effective date; post-approval sampling at least quarterly in permit years 2–5) but supplies none of the factual anchors needed to map those conditions onto FY2025: no permit effective date, no record of plan submission or approval, and no basis to identify which permit year(s) overlap Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30). Without those anchors, neither plan-submission nor sampling obligations can be established as applicable or inapplicable for that fiscal year. Per P5, unsupported uncertainty is preferred to unsupported closure; neither ACCEPT nor REJECT is grounded.
